## Soft Skill Coliseum Program by MindTree

News Date : 08 Feb 2023News ReportTraining & Placements Cell has conducted a “Training Session on Soft Skills in association with MindTree” on 08 February,2023  for B.Tech III Sem CSE, CSM & CSD students. The session has benefited the Students regarding Resume Building and Effective Communication and its importance in Campus Placements.
